description: Forward EPS consensus for one US stock, per fiscal quarter and fiscal year: mean, high, low, number of estimates, and the count of upward and downward revisions over the last 4 weeks. Use for "what does the Street expect AAPL to earn next quarter", "how many analysts estimate NVDA EPS". EPS only; no revenue consensus. Sourced live from Nasdaq's public analyst data.
name: analyst_forward_estimates
title: Analyst Forward Estimates
